exploratory_gate.signal: 1 minus Apple English sentence-embedding cosine distance between original and back-translation
exploratory_gate.interpretation: Useful quality signal to investigate; not proof of correctness and not ready as product gate. Threshold examined on these same exposed examples, with correlated sources across targets.

cost.candidate_policy: Keep12 annual local-first Base with bounded optional cloud allowance. Do not promise unlimited heavy cloud usage. Separate Bot mini revenue/entitlements remain unchanged.

direction.immediate_stage: Reviewed local phrase/word spans, with original text retained and native ranges protected. Expand attested phrase and construction packs, not arbitrary ngrams.
direction.asynchronous_stage: Whole-sentence local translation, readings and audio preparation. Evaluate sentence quality separately from replaceability of individual spans.
direction.uncertain_stage: Evaluate smaller local translation LM and optional cloud translator using bounded costs. Do not promote a cloud answer merely because it is fluent or self-reports confidence.
direction.full_sentence_flip: A meaningful whole translation may be suitable for full-sentence flip even when no safe fragment alignment exists.
direction.privacy: Local default for E2EE human chats; optional provider translation must explicitly disclose decrypted text processing. No real private conversations were sent.
direction.learning: Do not infer durable mastery merely from display or a model quality score.

remaining_evaluation: Independent calibration and untouched validation grouped by conversation, pair and error severity; score-vs-coverage curves instead of one universal probability.
Swahili actualMLKit and small-LM arm; Apple unsupported is not product support.
LLM forward-only vs local reverse vs dedicated reference-free QE: measured quality and billed tokens, no provider key currently available to this workstream.
Word/phrase correctness and actual mixed-language display must be scored separately from full-sentence translation.
NativeUI automatic progressive reveal, fixed geometry, transliteration and mixed audio latency/energy need evaluation once a candidate is selected.
preserved_holds: No store upload/submission, external purchase or public release
